_note: SkillLens canonical skill taxonomy. Each skill has a canonical name, aliases used for normalization, a category, a type and a short description. This file is shared by the Node.js server and the Python analysis pipeline. Aliases are matched case-insensitively unless listed in caseSensitiveAliases. Aliases in textExtractionStopAliases are too ambiguous for free-text descriptions (e.g. 'rest', 'node', 'less') and are only used when normalizing explicit skill lists.
